newsitem.title: FRANCE: France confirms selling 20 pct in France Telecom.
newsitem.headline: France confirms selling 20 pct in France Telecom.

text.p: French government spokesman Alain Lamassoure on Wednesday confirmed that the state aimed to sell 20 percent in telecommunications operator France Telecom from April, 1997.
He added that in the coming months the government would define what it saw as the public service mandate of telecommunications -- which France Telecom will continue to have to provide.
He also said the government would define the technical and financial details of interconnection access between France Telecom's infrastructure and that of rival operators.
Lamassoure was speaking after a cabinet meeting.
